Its liquidity remains in the pool and its separate hook fees remain collectible. The confirmed transaction is recorded in main-liquidity-lock.json. zkapi.daemonHostPlan: Shared-host pilot: one running job and daemon pair, fifty saved profiles, two CPU cores and 4 GiB aggregate memory cap with no swap. The authenticated gateway supports wallet-approved mainnet transactions, per-project funding approvals and owner-approved social publishing. Automatic maintenance operators require separate configuration. Move to a separate server before growing production workloads.
zkapi.reconciliationPolicy: Reserve each live model catalog cap plus a bounded 1000 microUSD rounding allowance before dispatch. Reconcile exact ETH charges only from authenticated durable native receipts bound to the saved call, session, journal and original quote; release unused budget once. Unknown or legacy calls stay held and inference is never automatically replayed. Real funded acceptance was deliberately not run.
